thread:
marta: Quick heads-up — planning to push v2 to prod in ~30m. Release notes are updated (minor schema rename, no auth changes). Canary to 5% tenants, then 25% after 15m if telemetry looks clean.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: v2-prod-rollout (canary=5%) starting 30 minutes from now. Runbook link: https://intranet/redwood/releases/v2-rollout. To abort: `/deploy cancel 1749994322`

kai: Is the rate-limit behaviour changing for tenant-specific quotas? Need to flag heavy-traffic customers.

marta: No change to quota logic, but v2 exposes per-request cost header which some SDKs might not parse. We'll add a fallback header mapping: `x-rd-token-cost -> x-rw-cost` on the gateway for known clients.

alex: There's a telemetry gap for eu-west for the last 24h — our v2 error baseline is noisy. Can we hold EU after canary and run a narrower probe? :eyes:

marta: Good call. Plan: canary globally 5%, but set eu-west probe to 1% and run 10m smoke queries against the top 20 tenants. If error rate > 3% for 5m we freeze and roll back.

sam: Proposal: pre-populate a tenant pinlist for any customer reporting SDK parsing issues, so we can auto-route them to v1. I can generate that list from support tickets.

liz: I'll draft support KB + release note blurb: "If you use older SDKs that rely on `x-rd-token-cost`, upgrade or contact support to be pinned to v1 temporarily." Also adding tos & examples.

marta: Ops, would like a hot-swap plan: if we see client-side crashes, we do a per-tenant route toggle rather than full rollback. Ops?

ops-bot: Hot-swap steps (operator manual):
```
# toggle tenant T123 to v1
curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.internal/toggle-route \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"tenant":"T123","route":"v1"}'

# roll forward
curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.internal/toggle-route \
  -d '{"tenant":"T123","route":"v2"}'
```
Followup: notify #support + the tenant owner.

kai: For the eu probe do we have throttling so the probe won't hit quota? We should mark probe requests as internal.

marta: Yes — mark as internal via header `x-rw-probe: true`. Will ensure quota exempt in gateway config.

deploy-bot: Canary start in 10m (auto-escalate window 30m). Monitoring: latency, 5xx ratio, client error churn. Alert thresholds: 5xx > 1.5x baseline OR new client crash signature seen -> auto-pause.

sam: I pushed a script to generate the pinlist: `scripts/generate_pinlist.py --since 7d --filter sdk=parse-error`. Will send output to ops paging channel.

liz: Release notes ready; tagging: #release-notes and #support. I'll add the KB link to the deploy message when it's live.

marta: Final call: proceed with canary in 10m. If anyone strongly objects pls raise now.

kai: ack from infra. I'll watch eu metrics for the first 20m.

alex: ack. I'll run the smoke queries for the top tenants post-canary.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 1749994350. Canary weight: 5%.

ops-bot: Reminder: if you need to pin a tenant, use `pin-tenants` playbook (ops-runbook/tenants/pin). Link: https://intranet/ops/pin-tenants

marta: Thanks team — we'll regroup at +25m for decision. :thumbsup:
